newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO ALUMINIUM FUTURES FINISH LOWER ON LME FALL.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO ALUMINIUM FUTURES FINISH LOWER ON LME FALL.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures finished lower on Wednesday with many players worried over the metal's future price movements following sharp falls on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, traders said.
"Sentiment is getting worse," said a trader at one of Japan's leading trading houses. "We're now watching whether the support at $1,700 will hold (on the LME)."
The June contract finished down 2.4 yen at 195.2 yen, while the April shed 2.7 yen to 196.3. Other contracts were down between 1.7 and 2.0 yen. Estimated volume was 3,470 lots.
In London overnight, benchmark three-month aluminium recovered to finish down $35 at $1,715 on chart-based support after briefly dropping below $1,700. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-6179
